decisionEvidence.quote: The payment service must retry failed transactions no more than 3 times. A retry is any request after the initial attempt; the initial attempt is not counted. Retries use exponential backoff.
decisionEvidence.title: ADR-PAY-001: Payment retry policy

findings.explanation: ADR-PAY-001 sets a fixed global retry cap (3) and backoff strategy for failed transactions, but does not address whether this cap or the retry behavior can be configured per merchant; the requirement asks for per-merchant configurability, a dimension the decision is silent on, making it unclear whether a fixed global limit still permits per-merchant variability (e.g., merchants having fewer retries within the cap) or conflicts with it.
findings.headline: Unclear against ADR-PAY-001
